title: Renewal Conditions for Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Plans
content:
These renewal conditions apply to every Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan, with the per-plan settings shown in the table.

**R1. Automatic renewal.** A plan renews automatically at the end of its term where its auto-renew setting is on. The table shows, for each plan, whether it renews automatically.

**R2. Day of the renewal charge.** A renewal is charged on the day after the plan's expiry date, the expiry date being the last valid day of the term.

**R3. Renewal reminder.** A renewal reminder is sent the number of calendar days shown before an annual renewal. The figure is 0 for plans that are not annual.

**R4. Declined renewal.** A declined renewal ends the plan at expiry, without retries.

## Settings by plan

| Plan | Renews automatically at term end | Reminder before an annual renewal (calendar days) | Renewal charged on | A declined renewal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | No | 0 | the day after the expiry date | ends the plan at expiry, no retry |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | No | 0 | the day after the expiry date | ends the plan at expiry, no retry |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | Yes | 0 | the day after the expiry date | ends the plan at expiry, no retry |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | Yes | 30 | the day after the expiry date | ends the plan at expiry, no retry |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | Yes | 30 | the day after the expiry date | ends the plan at expiry, no retry |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | Yes | 30 | the day after the expiry date | ends the plan at expiry, no retry |

## Condition, judgement, result

- *Condition:* the plan renews automatically and its term reaches its last valid day. *Result:* the renewal is charged the following day.
- *Condition:* that renewal charge is declined. *Result:* the plan ends at its expiry; the charge is not tried again.
- *Condition:* the plan is one of the three annual plans. *Result:* a reminder precedes the renewal by 30 calendar days. For the Monthly Pass, Day Pass and Pay As You Ride the reminder figure is 0.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A Wayfare Bikes Annual plan whose last valid day is 14 September, with auto-renew on, has its renewal charged on 15 September. Were that charge declined, the plan would end at its expiry on 14 September and no second attempt would be made.
